name: Kanade's Father
source:
The person who inspired [url=/c128189]Kanade[/url] to write and compose songs. He's currently hospitalized, and Kanade believes that it is her responsibility to create songs that can make people happy and save them, no matter who they are, in her father's stead as a form of atonement.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/ProjectSekai]TVTropes[/url]]
